headline: MessageResponseTable for chat, richer DataGrid presentation, and What's new on the community site
title: Aura & Community Updates
intro: Chat tables landed as MessageResponseTable, DataGrid picked up presentation and filter options, and the community site now publishes biweekly What's new reports.

highlights.summary: A DataGrid-backed table for chat responses, more ways to present and filter grids, and a public What's new page for shipped Aura and community work.

items.title: MessageResponseTable for chat
items.text: Assistant messages can render tables with DataGrid, including pagination, an expanded view, CSV download and resizable columns.
items.label: View Message in Storybook

image.alt: DataGrid table used as stand-in for MessageResponseTable (Chromatic master lag)

items.title: DataGrid presentation and filters
items.text: Grids can use striped rows, an emphasized header, wrapping cells, an overridable background and checklist column filter state.
items.label: View in Storybook

items.title: What's new on the community site
items.text: A biweekly What's new page ships native report pages from merged Aura and community work, with a review gate before publish.
items.label: Open What's new

image.alt: What's new page on the community site

thanks.summary: Seven people shipped or reviewed the work in this update.

components.summary: MessageResponseTable is new, DataGrid gained presentation options, and optional Selects can be cleared.

cards.title: MessageResponseTable
cards.subtitle: Aura
cards.text: A DataGrid renderer for tables inside chat responses, with pagination at 50 rows, expanded view, CSV export and resizable columns.
cards.label: View Message in Storybook

cards.title: DataGrid presentation
cards.subtitle: Aura
cards.text: Striped rows, emphasizeHeader, wrapCells and an overridable background give grids more layout control.
cards.label: View in Storybook

cards.title: DataGrid checklist filters
cards.subtitle: Aura
cards.text: Column filter state can drive a checklist so users pick multiple values in one panel.
cards.label: View in Storybook

cards.title: Clearable Select
cards.subtitle: Aura
cards.text: An optional Select can be cleared so users can remove a choice without picking a placeholder value.
cards.label: View in Storybook

context.summary: Four more Aura primitives got portable docs, and the community site gained the What's new reporting workflow.
